disposition_reason: EFSA novel food opinion printing applicant batch analyses of Wolffia globosa powder: arsenic, cadmium, lead and mercury in nine batches and other elements in seven, plus trace elements in six batches after a fertiliser change.

study.design: Regulatory safety assessment with applicant-supplied batch-to-batch analyses
study.origin: Wolffia globosa cultivated in PVC-sealed basins in greenhouses or semi-open mesh buildings (country not stated; product marketed in the US and Israel)
study.method: Heavy metals by ICP-MS (EN 15763:2009, AOAC 993.14 mod., J AOAC 90 (2007) 844-856 mod.); other elements by ICP-OES/ICP-MS
lod: Only as '<' values: As <0.1 (one batch); Cd <0.01; Hg <0.005 to <0.012 mg/kg
study.qa: Contract laboratory methods; no CRM data printed

findings.notes: Applicant-supplied batch analysis; dried powder, moisture 2.6-4.4%. Grown in PVC-sealed basins in greenhouses or mesh-net buildings (country not stated).
